specs: plan the foundation

Six iterations, each gating on make check and on a review that only a person
can give. Three add a required command that proves what the iteration claims
rather than asserting it: the fixture test behind every convention check, and
a diff against the committed stylesheet for the icon generator, which is what
makes the port from Python verifiable instead of trusted.

TODO.md holds what is not being worked on. Neither a person nor an agent
holds a project's outstanding work in their head, and only one of them gets
a nagging feeling about it.
